name: 10286-varlen-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (same weights) and the served adapter's own declared base_model_name_or_path; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 8B, bf16, ~16.1 GB of weights. One LoRA adapter on top: `algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora`, r=64, lora_alpha=16, on q_proj k_proj v_proj o_proj gate_proj.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=16 req/s, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts normal(240, 300) clamped 8-1024, generations normal(256, 160) clamped 8-1024, seed 42. Radix cache is disabled.
purpose: A fact-generation assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model with a LoRA adapter, serving 16 varied-length requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.3rc0 at commit 2689f0bf02a23e784405153738de134c3d4427b1.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The adapter is selected per request by the non-OpenAI `lora_path` body field, whose
# value is the name before `=` here; the `model` name does not select it.
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
lora-backend: triton

disable-radix-cache: true
